prompt:
Protect the API with keys and roles.
- Requests carry `Authorization: Bearer <key>`. Keys live in the data as `apiKeys: [{ "key", "name", "role" }]`; add one key per role to data/seed.json.
- Roles: `viewer` may only read (GET). `cook` may also cook recipes, record waste, log temperatures and enter stock-take counts. `manager` may do everything.
- A request without a key or with an unknown key is 401; a known key without permission is 403. Both answer in the usual error shape with their own error codes.
- Every request that changes data writes an audit entry (time, key name, method, path, status). `GET /audit` lists them newest first and is for managers only.
Update the existing tests so they send a key.

Work on your own; nobody will answer questions. When you finish, report: status `done` if you did the task, `not_found` if something the task names does not exist, `blocked` if you could not do it; `answer` holds any answer the task asks for (otherwise one short sentence); `changed` lists the files you changed.

report.answer: The API now checks a Bearer key on every request. Requests with no key or an unknown key get 401 `unauthorized`, and keys whose role lacks permission get 403 `forbidden`. A viewer may use only GET routes. A cook may also cook, record waste, log temperatures and enter stock-take counts; starting or finishing a stock-take is for managers only. Every request other than GET writes an audit entry, including ones that are refused or fail. `GET /audit` is for managers only and lists the entries newest first. `npm test` (30 pass) and `npm run lint` both pass. The existing tests now send the manager key by default through tests/helpers.js. I also added tests/access.test.js. data/seed.json has three development keys (dev-viewer-key, dev-cook-key, dev-manager-key). I did not change data/db.json, so `npm start` on it refuses every request until keys are added there. Any cron job calling `POST /jobs/nightly` will now need a manager key. I did not bump the schema version: `apiKeys` and `audit` are optional collections that default to empty, as earlier collections like `outbox` were added.

check.why: keys, roles, audit and docs all right
